mapper.sql: select id, category_id, video_id, sort_order, created_at, updated_at from category_video_sort
mapper.select: select cvs.id, cvs.category_id, cvs.video_id, cvs.sort_order, cvs.created_at, cvs.updated_at, c.name as category_name, v.id as v_id, v.title as v_title, v.cover_image as v_cover_image, v.published_at as v_published_at, v.sort_order as v_sort_order, v.view_count as v_view_count, v.status as v_status from category_video_sort cvs left join categories c on cvs.category_id = c.id left join videos v on cvs.video_id = v.id where cvs.category_id = #{categoryId} and v.status = 1 order by cvs.sort_order desc, v.published_at desc
select count(*) from category_video_sort where category_id = #{categoryId}

select v.id, v.title, v.subtitle, v.description, v.video_content, v.cover_image, v.duration, v.file_size, v.author, v.category_id, v.view_count, v.comment_count, v.like_count, v.share_count, v.sort_order, v.is_recommended, v.is_hot, v.status, v.published_at, v.last_edited_at, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.transcode_id, v.md5, v.shareid, v.orgfile, v.rpath, v.domain, v.path, v.suffix, v.resolution, v.bitrate, v.fps, v.width, v.height, v.transcode_status, v.thumbnails, v.output_formats, v.slug, v.meta_title, v.meta_description, v.meta_keywords, v.video_type, v.quality, v.is_featured, v.allow_comments, v.language from videos v inner join category_video_sort cvs on v.id = cvs.video_id where cvs.category_id = #{categoryId} and v.status = 1 order by cvs.sort_order desc, v.published_at desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
